Class IsoSurface

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.IsoSurface
public class IsoSurface extends Object
Creates and renders an iso surface of an ImageJ stack. The surface is extracted with the Surface Nets algorithm (smoother and more regular than marching cubes) from the (Gaussian smoothed) stack, the vertices are shared by the faces and the mesh is smoothed with the Taubin method (without shrinking). The surface is rendered with vertex buffers, smooth normals and a head light and can be exported as a Wavefront *.obj file.

    • load

      public boolean load(ij.ImagePlus imp)
      Loads a stack (the current channel and frame of a hyperstack) and computes the iso surface in the background. The default iso value is the threshold of the image (if set) or the center of the display range.
      Parameters:
      imp - the ImageJ image
      Returns:
      true if the stack has been loaded

    • setData

      public void setData(float[] values, int w, int h, int d)
      Sets the data of the iso surface (e.g., of a dynamic model) and computes the surface in the background. The values are copied.
      Parameters:
      values - the values (index = (z * height + y) * width + x)
      w - the width (x)
      h - the height (y)
      d - the depth (z)

    • setData

      public void setData(float[] values, int w, int h, int d, double voxelDepth)
      Sets the data of the iso surface (e.g., of a dynamic model) and computes the surface in the background. The values are copied. The iso value is kept if it has been set (see setIsoValue), else the center of the value range is used.
      Parameters:
      values - the values (index = (z * height + y) * width + x)
      w - the width (x)
      h - the height (y)
      d - the depth (z)
      voxelDepth - the depth of a voxel relative to its width

    • setColorData

      public void setColorData(float[] values)
      Sets an array for the colors of the surface (e.g., a heat map of another variable of a model). The array has the size and the layout of the data (see setData) and is kept for the following setData calls. The color mode is set to COLOR_INTENSITY (always, also after COLOR_DEPTH). The values are mapped to the colors of the color map (see setColorMap) with the color range (see setColorRange, default: the minimum and maximum of the array).
      Parameters:
      values - the values (index = (z * height + y) * width + x)

    • resetColors

      public void resetColors()
      Resets the color settings to the defaults: no color array (see setColorData), the value range of the data, the default color map (the LUT of the image or Viridis), no transfer function and the sample depth 1. The color mode is not changed. Useful at the start of a model, because the iso surface keeps the settings of a former model.

    • setMeasureResolution

      public void setMeasureResolution(int resolution)
      Sets the resolution of the measured surface: 1 measures the iso surface of the voxels of the stack (the default), 2 - 4 the iso surface of the stack upsampled with cubic interpolation (Catmull-Rom) by this factor in x, y and z (more accurate for small objects of a few voxels, the display is not changed). The factor is reduced if the upsampled stack would be too large.
      Parameters:
      resolution - the factor (1 - 4)

    • setTransferFunction

      public void setTransferFunction(com.eco.bio7.spatial.TransferFunction tf)
      Sets a transfer function for the colors (and with the opacity mapping for the opacities) of the surface. The color values (see the color mode and setColorData) are mapped with the color range (see setColorRange) to the positions 0 - 1 of the function. The color mode COLOR_SINGLE is changed to COLOR_INTENSITY. null removes the transfer function.
      Parameters:
      tf - the transfer function (copied) or null

    • exportMesh

      public static void exportMesh(File file, float[] positions, int[] indices, float[] vertexColors, String kind, String title, String unit) throws IOException
      Exports a triangle mesh (e.g., of a height map) like the iso surface (see export). The format is selected by the file extension (see EXPORT_FORMATS).
      Parameters:
      file - the file
      positions - x, y, z per vertex
      indices - three vertex indices per triangle
      vertexColors - r, g, b (0 - 1) per vertex or null
      kind - the kind of the mesh (for the comments of the files)
      title - the title (e.g., of the image)
      unit - the unit of the coordinates
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file can't be written or the format is unknown

    • exportMesh

      public static void exportMesh(File file, float[] positions, int[] indices, float[] vertexColors, float[] texCoords, BufferedImage texture, String kind, String title, String unit) throws IOException
      Exports a triangle mesh with a texture: OBJ (with a *.png file of the texture, see the *.mtl file) and glTF binary (the texture embedded, without the vertex colors which would be multiplied with the texture). The other formats use the vertex colors.
      Parameters:
      texCoords - u, v (0 - 1, v from the top of the image) per vertex or null
      texture - the texture image or null
      Throws:
      IOException
      See Also:
      • exportMesh(File, float[], int[], float[], String, String, String)

    • export

      public void export(File file) throws IOException
      Exports the iso surface. The format is selected by the file extension (obj, stl, ply, glb or vtk, see EXPORT_FORMATS). The coordinates are calibrated (the unit of the image).
      Parameters:
      file - the file
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file can't be written or the format is unknown

    • exportObj

      public void exportObj(File file) throws IOException
      Exports the iso surface as a Wavefront *.obj file (with a *.mtl file for the color). The coordinates are calibrated (the unit of the image).
      Parameters:

      Throws:
      IOException - if the file can't be written

    • setMesh

      public void setMesh(com.eco.bio7.loader3d.MeshData mesh, double scale, String unit)
      Displays an imported mesh (e.g., of the Model tab, see MeshModel) instead of the iso surface of a stack. The mesh can be measured (see Measurement3d), clipped, colored and exported like an iso surface (without the functions of the voxels, e.g., the region statistics).
      Parameters:
      mesh - the mesh (duplicate vertices merged, see MeshData.weld)
      scale - the size of a unit of the file in the unit (e.g., 0.001 for a file in mm and the unit m)
      unit - the unit of the measurements

    • setSelection

      public void setSelection(ValueSelection selection)
      Sets the values of the stack for the iso surface (used by the next load, a loaded stack is loaded again): ValueSelection.ALL (the iso surface of the iso value, the default), ValueSelection.IMAGE_THRESHOLD (the values in the threshold of the image in ImageJ, e.g., only the particles), a range of values (ValueSelection.range) or the labels of a segmentation (ValueSelection.labels). With a selection the iso value is not used.
      Parameters:
      selection - the selection (null = all values)
